rows.note: Use this as the everyday term for your wife's father.

example.english: I arranged to have tea with my father-in-law tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 joek3 zo2 ngoi6 fu2 jam2 caa4

rows.note: Use this for your husband's father, especially when speaking from the wife's side of the family.

example.english: My father-in-law is ill, so I have to go back to see him today.
example.traditional: 我老爺病咗，我今日要返去睇佢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 lou5 je4 beng6 zo2 ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 faan1 heoi3 tai2 keoi5
